description: Two oscillators sweeping between square and saw, crossfaded to one output, with a separate sine wave following oscillator A

params.text: Fine-tunes both oscillators and the sine together, a tritone down at -2 and a tritone up at +2
Shifts oscillator A in whole octaves, -5 to 4, with -1 giving C4 for 0V at the V/OCT input
Shifts oscillator B in whole octaves, -5 to 4, with -1 giving C4 for 0V at the V/OCT input
Crossfades oscillator A between a square wave fully left and a saw wave fully right
Crossfades oscillator B between a square wave fully left and a saw wave fully right
Sets the pulse width of the square part of oscillator A, clamped between 1% and 99%; the saw part of the wave is unchanged
Sets the pulse width of the square part of oscillator B, clamped between 1% and 99%; the saw part of the wave is unchanged
Crossfades the OUT jack between oscillator A fully left and oscillator B fully right

inputs.text: 1V per octave for both oscillators and the sine, and the channel count here sets the module's polyphony; with OCT A at -1, 0V gives C4 at 261.63Hz
Adds to the SHAPE A knob, a tenth of the crossfade per volt, clamped at square and at saw; only the first channel of a polyphonic cable is read
Adds to the SHAPE B knob, a tenth of the crossfade per volt, clamped at square and at saw; only the first channel of a polyphonic cable is read
Adds to the PW A knob, a tenth of the pulse width per volt, read per channel on a polyphonic cable
Adds to the PW B knob, a tenth of the pulse width per volt, read per channel on a polyphonic cable
Adds to the MIX knob, a tenth of the crossfade per volt, clamped at oscillator A alone and at oscillator B alone

outputs.text: A sine wave at the pitch of oscillator A, -5V to 5V, unchanged by SHAPE A, PW A and MIX
Oscillator A and oscillator B crossfaded by MIX, -5V to 5V
